labels.text: Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.01.needs: a microphone; a browser that supports voice input (Chrome or Edge per the button hint)
S49.01.note: The keyboard shortcut Toggle dictation (Ctrl+Cmd+Shift+S) also starts it, per packages/ui/unified-chat/src/lib/shortcutRegistry.ts; the button label is a translation key with this text as default, and I did not check the translation files.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat so the message box is visible.
Click the microphone button labelled Start voice input.
Speak one sentence; the strip shows a moving waveform and the Voice dictation group is visible.
Click the square button labelled Stop recording and edit the transcript.
Look: the spoken words appear as text in the message box, ready to edit.
S49.01.where: Chat message box (composer) > Start voice input (microphone button beside the send button)

labels.text: Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.02.note: Pressing Enter while recording sends the dictated text immediately (DictationStrip.tsx handleKeyDown), so the edit-first path is the Stop button.
steps: Click Start voice input and speak a sentence.
Click Stop recording and edit the transcript (not Enter, which sends at once).
Wait for the transcript to appear in the message box.
Click into the text, change a word, and check the edit is kept.
Look: the message is not sent until you press the send button; the edited text is what gets sent.
S49.02.where: Chat message box (composer) > Start voice input > Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.03.needs: a microphone; a second language you can speak
S49.03.note: The Settings navigation label for the Voice section was not confirmed; the dropdown options come from SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES as native names.
steps: Open Settings and go to the Voice section.
Turn on the Dictation switch, which enables the language dropdown.
Open the Dictation language dropdown and choose a different language.
Go back to the chat, click Start voice input, speak in that language, then stop.
Look: the transcript is written in the chosen language, as Expected.
S49.03.where: Settings > Voice > Dictation language (dropdown; the Settings path to the Voice section was not traced)

steps: Dictate a sentence with Start voice input.
Click Stop recording and edit the transcript.
Watch the strip show Transcribing with a spinner.
Wait until the spinner stops.
Look: the complete final transcript is in the message box, after any text that was already there.
S49.05.where: Chat message box (composer) > Start voice input > Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.06.needs: a microphone; a way to switch off the internet (for example Wi-Fi off)
S49.06.note: When a usage limit is reached the button reads Upgrade instead of Try again; the error close button is labelled Dismiss voice input error.
steps: Click Start voice input and speak a sentence.
Turn off the internet connection before stopping, so transcription fails.
Click Stop recording and edit the transcript; wait for the red error text in the strip.
Turn the connection back on and click Try again.
Look: the transcript appears without recording again.
S49.06.where: Chat message box (composer) > Start voice input > Stop recording and edit the transcript > Try again (shown after an error)

S49.07.note: Pressing Escape while the strip is open also discards the recording (DictationStrip.tsx handleKeyDown).
steps: Click Start voice input and speak a sentence.
Click the X button labelled Discard recording.
Look: the strip closes and the message box is unchanged, with no text added and nothing sent.
S49.07.where: Chat message box (composer) > Start voice input > Discard recording (round X button at the left of the strip)

S49.09.note: The batch request is transcribeViaServer in apps/web/features/chat/stores/voice-input-store.ts, posting to apps/web/app/api/voice/transcribe/route.ts; I did not read the route body.
steps: Click Start voice input and speak a longer sentence.
Click Stop recording and edit the transcript.
Watch the Transcribing spinner; no text appears while speaking.
Look: the whole transcript appears in one piece when transcription finishes.
S49.09.where: Effect seen after Chat message box > Start voice input > Stop recording and edit the transcript: the text arrives all at once

S49.10.needs: a microphone; a plan that allows voice mode (not checked)
S49.10.note: Dictation itself is batch, not streaming; the streaming code is in the voice mode path (apps/web/features/chat/lib/live-voice-session.ts), and I did not confirm that the text is shown on screen while speaking.
steps: Leave the message box empty and click the button labelled Start voice mode.
Speak a sentence slowly while the voice screen is open.
Look: whether words appear as text while you are still speaking, as Expected.
S49.10.where: Chat message box (composer) with empty text > Start voice mode (voice entry button on the right)

S49.17.needs: a microphone; a fresh start of voice capture
S49.17.note: Searched apps/web/features/chat/components/Voice, apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer and VoiceSection.tsx for consent, recorded and notice; no pre-capture consent screen found. The only related text is the microphone purpose Dictation and voice conversations in packages/contracts/local-runtime/src/desktop-privacy.ts, which is a system permission review line, not a shown notice.

S49.25.note: The export covers the whole chat history, not a separate recording transcript; the title menu trigger control itself was not labelled in the code I read.
steps: Open a conversation that contains dictated text.
Open the conversation's title menu (the menu that holds Export…).
Click Export….
Choose a format in the Export Chat History dialog and click its export button.
Look: a file downloads and contains the dictated text.
S49.25.where: Open a conversation > conversation title menu > Export…

S49.27.needs: a conversation; a workspace admin account to see retention settings
S49.27.note: The Settings path to WorkspacePolicySection was not traced, and whether Delete asks for confirmation was not verified.
steps: Open a conversation that contains dictated text.
Open the conversation's title menu and click Delete.
Read and confirm any prompt that appears.
Look: the conversation disappears from the sidebar and cannot be reopened.
For the retention setting, go to the workspace policy section with the Retention window and Enforce retention fields and check they are shown.
S49.27.where: Open a conversation > conversation title menu > Delete (retention window is in the workspace policy settings and needs a workspace admin)

S49.30.needs: a microphone; a chat message box
S49.30.note: Dictated text is added through appendComposerMessage in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx; I searched ChatComposerNew.tsx and use-dictation.ts for undo and found no dictation-specific undo handling, so Cmd+Z behaviour is unverified.
